current_evidence: The council's Submit/fees/forms page links this 'Worthing planning application validation requirements' PDF under 'Local planning validation list' and says 'This will come into effect on 1st April 2026'. The PDF itself has no date.

issues.detail: Grokbot linked the right PDF but never read it: docs_read lists only the web page, and only 4 items were captured. It missed the PDF's general local requirements (Nos. 7-46), including: Additional Plans and Drawings (all planning applications); Planning Statement (all applications, proportionate); Refuse and Recycling Provision (all developments); Parking Provision (all full applications, existing/proposed block plans at 1:200); Space Standards Matrix (all new dwellings incl. conversions; M4(2) and 3% M4(3) affordable); Self-build and Custom Build Statement (all self/custom-build dwellings); Air Source Heat Pumps (any proposal installing an ASHP); Ventilation and Air Conditioning Statement (substantial ventilation/extraction, ASHPs, AC plant); Telecommunications Development (all telecoms); South Downs National Park Statement (all applications adjacent to the National Park).
issues.evidence: PDF 'Validation Requirements' table pp.14-46, e.g. Planning Statement: 'Required for all applications (proportionate and specific to the development).'

issues.detail: Missing environmental and technical requirements: Air Quality Assessment (proposals that may significantly affect air quality, incl. in/near an AQMA); Biodiversity Net Gain (minor and major, except S73 where the original permission was not subject to BNG); Ecological Appraisal (designated sites/habitats, brownfield, demolition or roof works, tree/scrub/hedgerow removal, watercourses, within 500 m of a pond); Land Contamination Assessment (brownfield, within 250 m of landfill, sensitive end uses); Lighting Assessment (significant external lighting affecting amenity, countryside, South Downs Dark Skies Reserve or heritage); Noise Impact Assessment; Daylight/Sunlight and Overshadowing (major schemes; constrained smaller sites if requested); Historic Environment Record desk-based assessment (sites with archaeological interest); Tree Survey and Arboricultural Method Statement (development near trees/hedges, TPO trees, trees in CAs); Sustainable Drainage Systems (sites over 1 ha or where FRA requires; hydrogeological risk assessment in SPZ1); Visual Impact Assessment (significant townscape/landscape impact; photomontages for heritage); Landscape and Green Infrastructure details (all Strategic Sites; any tree loss).

Missing major-development and use-specific requirements: Affordable Housing Statement and viability (10+ dwellings); Energy and Sustainability Statement (major: 10+ homes or 1,000+ m2; and all new-build housing); Fire Statement (new buildings with 2+ dwellings or educational accommodation that are 18 m+ or 7+ storeys); Foul Sewerage Assessment (major; new/changed foul systems); Health Impact Assessment and Screening (major); Statement of Community Involvement (all major and telecoms); Road Safety Audit (20+ homes or 2,000+ m2 with highway changes); Transport Assessment / Transport Statement / Travel Plan; Planning Obligations / Heads of Terms (where S106 likely); Community Facilities Statement (loss or new community facilities); Economic Statement (net loss of employment floorspace or visitor facilities); Town Centre Uses Sequential Test and Impact Assessment (main town-centre uses out of centre; impact for leisure/office over 2,500 m2 or retail 500 m2+); Environmental Statement (EIA development).

Householder (and the other non-Full types) are marked '(none) - national requirements only', which is wrong. The PDF has no application-type matrix, but many requirements apply to 'all applications' or are triggered by location or works, so they cover householder schemes: Additional Plans and Drawings, Planning Statement, Refuse and Recycling, Air Source Heat Pumps, Heritage Statement (in or adjoining a Conservation Area), Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zones 2/3), Ecological Appraisal (roof works) and Tree Survey (near trees). The '(none)' rows also cite the PDF as source although Grokbot never read it.
issues.evidence: Additional Plans and Drawings: 'All planning applications.'; Air Source Heat Pumps: 'All proposals that involve the installation of an ASHP.'

issues.detail: The Flood Risk Assessment trigger is vague web-page text with a navigation fragment ('to top Flood risk assessment A flood risk assessment may be required depending on the location...'). The PDF sets precise triggers: sites of 1 ha+ in Flood Zone 1; all new development in Flood Zones 2 and 3; and more vulnerable uses at increased flood risk.
issues.evidence: PDF No. 19: 'A site-specific Flood Risk Assessment must be submitted with planning applications for:'

issues.detail: The Heritage Statement trigger is a navigation fragment ('- on the Planning Portal website Back to top Heritage statement The scope and degree of detail...') and gives no trigger. The PDF requires it for: all Listed Building Consent applications; development in or adjoining a Conservation Area (except changes of use); sites near scheduled monuments or registered parks and gardens; known or suspected archaeology; and impacts on heritage assets. Grokbot also filed it only under Full planning ('INFERRED'), although the PDF names LBC explicitly.
issues.evidence: PDF No. 22: 'Required for: All applications for Listed Building Consent.' and 'A Heritage Statement is required for all development proposals that may impact on the historic environment.'

issues.detail: Both Listed building consent rows come from the web page (older joint Adur & Worthing guidance), not the current Worthing list. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' does not appear in the Worthing PDF at all. The 'Structural Survey' trigger ('in support of an application for listed building consent') is not the PDF trigger, which is: refurbishment or re-use of listed or historic buildings; refurbishment of non-designated heritage assets in Conservation Areas; and substantial or total demolition of heritage assets. The PDF's actual LBC minimum (site plan, drawings, DAS and Heritage Statement) is not captured.
issues.evidence: PDF 'Other Application Types': 'A site plan, drawings, design and access statement and heritage statement should be provided as a minimum.'

issues.detail: Advertisement consent is marked '(none)', but the PDF's 'Other Application Types' section asks for details of each advertisement, including lighting levels, plus sections showing how adverts are fixed and illuminated.
issues.evidence: PDF pp.9-10 'Other Application Types' - Advertisement Consent

issues.detail: All 3 tab_items are process or fee text from the web page, not validation requirements: the suggestion to submit a surface water drainage checklist to speed up review; the GBP 75 (+VAT) admin charge for postal/email submissions; and the note that tree-work applications carry no admin charge.

summary: Grokbot's link and 1 April 2026 date are correct for the new Worthing-only list, but it never read the PDF. Of the ~40 local requirements only Flood Risk and Heritage are captured (with garbled triggers), the LBC rows come from older web-page text, and the tab items are fees and process text.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
